How to read these numbers

  1. The 174 original requirements and 28 additive upgrades are separate denominators.
  2. Recorded open does not mean missing code; recorded implemented does not mean accepted.
  3. Committed source, local test coverage and final acceptance are separate measures and must not be added together.
  4. The one historical VERIFIED clause covers source integrity only, not the whole product or its parent.
  5. Named local clause results overlap with full test profiles; no unique-test total is inferred.
  6. Concrete remaining actions come from the detailed work record. Original work and exact acceptance wording are retained; latest scoped evidence is displayed beside them.
  7. This view never mutates the backlog, acceptance register, upgrade register or their historical statuses.
